items.title: New monthly price takes effect
items.quote: erhöht sich der monatliche Grundpreis Ihres Tarifs „Muster DSL 250“ ab dem 01.04.2026 von 39,99 € auf 44,99 €.
items.computation: The letter states the new price of 44,99 € (from 39,99 €) applies from the fixed calendar date given in the letter: 01.04.2026.

items.title: Exercise special cancellation right (Sonderkündigungsrecht, § 57 TKG)
items.quote: Sie können Ihren Vertrag innerhalb von drei Monaten nach Zugang dieser Mitteilung ohne Einhaltung einer Frist und ohne Kosten kündigen, frühestens zum Zeitpunkt des Wirksamwerdens der Änderung (§ 57 TKG).
items.computation: The 3-month window runs 'nach Zugang' (from receipt), not from the document date, but the letter does not state the actual delivery/receipt date. Taking the earliest plausible reading, Zugang is assumed on the letter's own date, 16.02.2026 (Monday) — the real receipt date, and hence the real deadline, could be a few days later if the letter took time in the post. Counting starts the day after Zugang (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB): 17.02.2026. Three months later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) is 16.05.2026, a Saturday. Termination/notice deadlines do not shift to the next business day when they fall on a weekend or holiday (BGH III ZR 172/04), so the notice must reach NetzMuster GmbH by Saturday 16.05.2026 at the latest; since weekend delivery is not guaranteed, it should safely arrive by Friday 15.05.2026 (send in good time, e.g. by 08.05.2026). This special right can only be used to end the contract at the earliest as of 01.04.2026, when the price change takes effect.

warnings: The 3-month cancellation window legally starts on the day the letter is actually received (Zugang), not its printed date; since the actual delivery date is unknown, 16.02.2026 was used as the earliest plausible start — if the letter arrived later, the true deadline is correspondingly later, so verify the actual delivery date if possible.

The calculated deadline (16.05.2026) falls on a Saturday; because termination deadlines do not move to the next business day, the cancellation notice should be sent early enough to arrive by Friday 15.05.2026 to be safe.
